# Data Source: tfe_registry_provider_version

This data source can be used to retrieve a provider version from the private registry.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Retrieve a specific provider version

data "tfe_registry_provider_version" "example" {
  organization = "my-org-name"
  name         = "my-provider"
  version      = "1.0.0"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the provider.
- `version` (String) The version of the provider.

### Optional

- `namespace` (String) The namespace of the provider. For private providers this is the same as the organization.
- `organization` (String) Name of the organization. If omitted, organization must be defined in the provider config.
- `registry_name` (String) Whether this is a publicly maintained provider or private. Must be either `public` or `private`. Defaults to `private`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The time when the provider version was created.
- `id` (String) ID of the provider version.
- `key_id` (String) The GPG key ID used to sign the provider version.
- `platforms` (Attributes List) List of platform release files for this provider version. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--platforms))
- `protocols` (List of String) An array of Terraform provider API versions that this version supports.
- `shasums_sig_uploaded` (Boolean) Indicates whether the SHASUMS signature file has been uploaded.
- `shasums_uploaded` (Boolean) Indicates whether the SHASUMS file has been uploaded.
- `updated_at` (String) The time when the provider version was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--platforms"></a>
### Nested Schema for `platforms`

Read-Only:

- `filename` (String) The filename of the provider binary.
- `id` (String) ID of the provider version platform.
- `name` (String) Name of the provider.
- `namespace` (String) The namespace of the provider.
- `organization` (String) Name of the organization.
- `os_arch` (String) A valid operating system string and architecture string, separated by an underscore (e.g., 'linux_amd64').
- `provider_binary_uploaded` (Boolean) Indicates whether the provider binary has been uploaded.
- `registry_name` (String) Whether this is a publicly maintained provider or private.
- `registry_provider_id` (String) ID of the parent provider version.
- `shasum` (String) The SHA256 checksum of the provider binary.
- `version` (String) The version string.
